- 2 -

Any retailer or vendor of lumber who refuses to sell
any of the wood species specified in Section 1 hereof, displayed in
his lumber yard or place of business, at the price fixed by this Or-
der shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of Section
3 of Commonwealth Act No. 600, as amended.

All retailers or vendors of lumber are hereby required
to post in a conspicuous place at the entrance of their lumber yards
or places of business, or within said premises, a copy of the schedule
of prices provided in this Order.

All Executive Orders and all Emergency Control Administra-
tion Orders or any of the provisions thereof which are in conflict or
inconsistent with this Order or any of its provisions are hereby repealed.

This Executive Order shall take effect July 15, 1947.
Done at the City of Manila, this 27 th day of June, in the year
of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-seven, and of the Independence
of the Philipbines, the first.
By the President:
•
EMILIO ABELIO
Chief of the Executive Office
